about: The company's own warehouse and showroom addresses, from the official site https://houzscentury.com/ (fetched 2026-11-17; owner confirmed they are public). Read by scripts/fill-master-postcodes.mjs: a scm.warehouses row matches when its name or code equals one of `names` ignoring case. The street is written into an empty `location` only; City/State are written from scm.my_localities for the postcode. Not listed on purpose (no fixed address): GUANGZHOU WAREHOUSE, Consignment (Out), CASH & CARRY SEGMENT - FAIR.
